Working on SLOTPLAN-115 (shift_weekly). The design-review notes on the edge-case decisions for this function are held by someone on the wider team — could whoever has them share them here? In particular: (1) for entries that run past midnight (end>1440), when the shift moves them across a day boundary, do we keep them as a single (day,start,end) tuple with end possibly >1440, or split them into two entries? (2) Any rule about entries that wrap to the same day? Thanks!
